contract1_bodyPreservation.details: All 12 frames body256 are 100% byte-identical to repair1 body-specialist (back_l-Sword-full/body256/). All 12 frames in native 128x128 have exactly 0 RGBA pixel delta.

contract2_structuralKeysPreservation.details: Structural keys F03 (01-hoist), F04 (02-apex), F07 (03-impact) are byte-identical in body256 and have 0 pixel delta in native 128 against approved repair1 sources.

contract3_attackOnlyV1Policy.details: visibleInterval is strictly [2, 8]. Bookends F00, F01, F09, F10, F11 have completely transparent weaponBack, weaponFront, and handFront layers (0 non-transparent pixels). Composites are 100% byte-identical to the unarmed body.

contract4_fourLayerMasters.details: All four canonical Aseprite masters verified on disk with exact declared SHA-256 hashes: composite.aseprite (d052b991...), body.aseprite (f2deef7c...), hand.aseprite (c16ea537...), native.aseprite (d9280bbf...). Timing array [40, 60, 60, 70, 70, 40, 40, 90, 70, 70, 60, 60] ms = 730 ms verified in headers.

contract5_swordKinematicsAndArc.details: Trajectory angles [10°, 350°, 320°, 285°, 265°, 245°, 240°] form a coherent, physically grounded diagonal slash across the rear torso. Uses authentic recruit-sword asset (weapon.json SHA 7c090d89...), distinct from axe chop.

contract6_groundClearance.details: Lowest weapon pixel reaches y=174 in F07 and y=179 in F08, maintaining 16px and 11px clearance above ground floor groundY=190. Zero subterranean penetration or foot/leg collision.

frameByFrameAudit.visualObservation: Unarmed rear-left guard; arms down, occipital skull and vertebral channel clean; equipment empty.
Right shoulder initiates windup shift; equipment completely transparent.
Glove wraps hilt securely at [163, 108]; blade rises upright at 10°; guard and pommel cleanly positioned.
Structural key F03 preserved. High chamber near neck/pauldron, angle 350°; blade raised upright-backward ready to cut.
Structural key F04 preserved. Arm extends into forward diagonal thrust; blade cuts at 320° across north-west perspective.
Mid-slash diagonal cleave at 285°; blade sweeps cleanly across torso/dorsal line without armor clipping.
Deep diagonal descent at 265°; right fist [150, 119] guides sword horizontally-diagonally across back.
Structural key F07 preserved. Follow-through impact at 245°; blade low to the left (lowest Y=174); pommel and crossguard clear.
Low rebound deceleration at 240°; blade lowest Y=179 stays 11px above groundY=190; clean transition into recovery.
Unarmed recovery stance; hands return towards neutral pelvis posture; equipment completely transparent.
Unarmed return towards guard posture; parent body preserved.
Final unarmed guard pose; seamless one-shot terminal state; zero equipment pixels.

limitations: Inspection conducted through discrete still frames, 4x zooms, layer separations, and tactical 64px scale renders.
Functional Chromium playback verified 730ms / 1460ms wall-clock timings, one-shot stop at F11, and 1x/0.5x stepping.
Perceptual experience of continuous fluid motion in live game engine runtime remains the prerogative of the creator.
Scope is strictly limited to back_l/Sword; does not automatically approve other rear clips, the 28-cell matrix, or Unity integration.
